findings.distinctFindingRationale: Newly screened primary report; one study, not independent replication of its multiple readouts.
findings.subject: entity-mn-c3-activation
findings.text: In a small retrospective antigen-subtype comparison, NELL1-associated membranous nephropathy showed lower glomerular C3 and C4d deposition than PLA2R-associated disease. This qualifies extrapolation of a uniform complement-injury pathway across antigen subtypes; deposition differences do not directly establish functional complement activity or slit-diaphragm injury.
findings.quote: Glomerular IgG4 and C3 deposition were significantly lower in NELL1-associated MN.
findings.studySystem: Human retrospective kidney-biopsy comparison: 17 PLA2R-associated and 9 NELL1-associated MN cases; immunostaining and available glomerular proteomics.
limitations: Small retrospective cohort with antigen-associated differences in age and chronic damage; residual confounding remains.
C3, C5 and factor H proteomic differences were numerically higher in PLA2R-associated MN but not statistically significant.
C4d did not significantly correlate with serum anti-PLA2R titres. C4d deposition alone does not identify classical versus lectin pathway activity.
The study did not directly test complement-mediated slit-diaphragm damage; the finding is a scope qualification to that branch, not a new causal experiment.
